# Project Sheldon — LuaVM

> Sheldon LuaVM is a customizable Lua scripting environment for Roblox. This file indexes the documentation for AI assistants and LLMs.

## Documentation

- [LuaVM Documentation](https://projectsheldon.me/luavm/): Full scripting reference — globals, GUI, ImGui, drawing, input, files, internet, memory, cheat, tween, entities, instances, signals and more.
- [LuaVM Documentation (full plain text)](https://projectsheldon.me/llms-full.txt): Every documentation section concatenated as one markdown file — the most reliable source for AI systems.
- [API Docs](https://projectsheldon.me/api-docs/): Project Sheldon API reference.
